Sofia, the door 6 lamp delivery is on **Pellow** (Pellow Home Living, renamed from Covey & Lark Retail), not Pellucid.

You and Kwame settled it in #coastal-team on 17 February. You said PHL with the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments is Pellow, and Kwame confirmed the lamp delivery at door 6 was your retail account, not the container pickup. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal side. Source: #coastal-team, Feb 17.
